prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1235; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has since been treated for injuries that are ongoing. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any other coverage information available under that policy. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total loss records, claim file materials, witness statements, recorded calls, and any telematics data. Please ensure that no vehicle involved in the collision is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of until all parties have had an opportunity to inspect it.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
